title: Balance Sheet Audit Trail
summary: Upload a workbook with SOFP, Trial Balance and General Ledger sheets and get an end-to-end audit trail for every Balance Sheet line, tracing reported closing balances down to the supporting TB accounts and GL transactions, with reconciliation differences and unmapped accounts flagged.
prompt: when i hover on view transcations/unmap when one of the sofp is expanded its blue over blue and affects readibility can you fix that
assumptions: SOFP sheet has a year-header row and the most recent year's column is the reported closing balance for each line
TB sheet has Debit/Credit columns (or a single Closing Balance column); when multiple Debit/Credit pairs exist, the one labelled End/Closing is used, else the rightmost pair
GL sheet has one block per account with an account-name row, optional Initial Balance row, and transaction rows with Date/Debit/Credit/Balance
Automatic TB-to-SOFP and GL-to-TB matching uses name similarity plus generic accounting terminology hints and may need manual correction via the unmapped-accounts UI
gaps: Note-linked disclosure sheets (e.g. fixed-asset or grant schedules referenced by a Note column) are not cross-referenced automatically
Sign-convention mismatches are flagged, not auto-corrected, since conventions vary by source system
expects: An .xlsx/.xlsm workbook with at least a Statement of Financial Position (SOFP) sheet, a Trial Balance sheet, and a General Ledger sheet (sheet names configurable in the UI if they differ from the sample's 'SOFP', 'TB New 2025', 'GL New 2025')

history.prompt: Create a generic Balance Sheet Audit Support feature that accepts an uploaded Excel workbook (following the same structure as the provided sample workbook) as input. The workbook will contain at least three sheets: "SOFP", "TB New 2025", and "GL New 2025" (or equivalent configurable sheet names). The feature should automatically read the workbook, identify the Statement of Financial Position (SOFP), Trial Balance (TB), and General Ledger (GL) data, and generate an end-to-end audit trail for every Balance Sheet head. For each SOFP closing balance, identify the relevant TB and GL account(s), derive the closing balance from the underlying GL data, present a detailed breakup showing how the reported balance is composed, reconcile the aggregated GL balance with the reported SOFP balance, and clearly flag any differences, missing mappings, or unreconciled amounts. The output should be a structured audit report that enables Finance and Audit teams to trace every reported Balance Sheet figure back to its supporting ledger accounts and transactions without manually reviewing the entire General Ledger. The implementation should work for any uploaded workbook that follows the same tabular structure as the sample, rather than being hardcoded to a specific file.
